name: Host toolset
responsibility: The built-in tool namespaces as the host names them: each role's reviewed template filled with the host's name, digested over the bytes Codex gets, and the role a call came through
description: createVoiceToolset fills the workhorse and voice templates of the tool contract and the coordinator's tell_coordinator namespace with the host's names, and the product name for the callback's description. toolRoleOf answers which role a call came through by its namespace and manifest digest, so nothing past the Codex boundary compares a literal name. Archboard names them archboard_workhorse, archboard_voice and archboard_coordinator; a host that names none gets voice_workhorse, voice_channel and voice_coordinator.
